title: AffectWorld: Benchmarking Emotion-Driven Future World Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.18305v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The world encompasses both physical environments and human actors. Predicting its evolution requires understanding both physical laws and how emotions shape human actions. However, existing world model benchmarks primarily assess physical plausibility and perceptual quality, leaving emotion-driven world evolution largely untested.We introduce AffectWorld, a benchmark that evaluates the chain Emotion-Action-World State through three tasks: World-State Consistency, Emotion-Action Consistency, and Causal Consistency. It comprises 1,498 everyday video samples annotated with plausible emotions, action tendencies, and atomic world-state constraints. A counterfactual subset of 233 samples tests whether changing an agent's emotion under fixed scene and event conditions yields corresponding changes in actions and consequences. translated_title: AffectWorld：情绪驱动的未来世界预测基准测试
translated_abstract: 世界既包括物理环境，也包括人类行为者。预测世界的演化既需要理解物理定律，也需要理解情绪如何塑造人类行为。然而，现有的世界模型基准主要评估物理合理性和感知质量，情绪驱动的世界演化在很大程度上尚未被测试。我们提出了AffectWorld，这是一个通过三项任务评估“情绪-行动-世界状态”链条的基准：世界状态一致性、情绪-行动一致性和因果一致性。该基准包含1,498个日常视频样本，标注了合理的情绪、行动倾向和原子级世界状态约束。其中233个样本构成反事实子集，用于测试在固定的场景和事件条件下，改变主体的情绪是否会导致相应的行动和后果变化。我们在三项任务上定义了八个指标以及一个额外的反事实指标，并结合自动视觉评估……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出AffectWorld基准，首次系统评估世界模型中情绪驱动的“情绪-行动-世界状态”演化链条，弥补了现有基准仅关注物理合理性和感知质量的空白。
en_tdlr: AffectWorld is the first benchmark to systematically evaluate emotion-driven world evolution in world models through the Emotion-Action-World State chain, filling the gap left by existing benchmarks that only assess physical plausibility and perceptual quality.
